comment: Variation of cad-demon-hero-takes-pick-from-sack-in-shop: the same shop and form, but the hero is made deaf first (#wizintrinsic), so the keeper only glares at the pick. She then drops a wished Candelabrum of Invocation (shk.c special_stock() 3134-3138: a deaf hero sees the keeper, who is not Izchak, shake his head in refusal), wears a wished dunce cap (a silver ring of adornment cannot be handled in demon form) and picks up candles, priced by get_cost() with the dunce-cap surcharge (2948).
